verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at signoz.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with indexed doc entries, and Markdown versions of the docs pages (e.g. /docs/introduction/.md) that agents can consume directly. SigNoz also publishes an agent-oriented skill.md and Agent Skills that teach AI assistants to search its docs. Missing for 10: no independent or community report of agents actually using the llms.txt or .md docs in practice, and no evidence of a full-content variant such as llms-full.txt.
